[P1] Presentation alternatives
|
|-- document.alternatives: choices per presentationId
|   |-- alternative: name, diagramId, optional reviewId
|   |-- parts[]: target (whole diagram or subtree nodeRef)
|   |   `-- pinned source revision/scope and base revision
|   |-- selected[presentationId]: independent choice IDs
|   `-- panels[]: attached SidePanel records
|-- promote: disjoint parts from one base; retain ancestry
|-- select: swap all parts; replace overlaps explicitly
|   `-- nested choices require their selected parent
|-- project: compose source rows and provenance
|   `-- displayed rows change; bound revision stays fixed
`-- sidePanel: compare one pinned part in regular/diff
    `-- attached to placement and logical nodeRef

Canvas checkpoints retain choices, panels, and revisions.
